questions.question: Which river is the national river of India?
questions.funFact: The Ganga was declared India's national river in 2008 and is worshipped as 'Ganga Maa'.

questions.question: The Yamuna river flows past which famous monument in Agra?
questions.funFact: The Taj Mahal was built right beside the Yamuna, and the river's reflection adds to its beauty.

questions.question: The Ganga river begins from which Himalayan glacier?
questions.funFact: The Ganga starts as an icy stream from the Gangotri glacier high up in Uttarakhand.

questions.question: The Godavari is the longest river of South India.
questions.funFact: The Godavari is so important in the south that it is lovingly called 'Dakshin Ganga', the Ganga of the South.

questions.question: The river that flows through Assam and often causes big floods is the ___.
questions.funFact: The Brahmaputra is one of the few Indian rivers with a male name and carries a huge amount of water.

questions.question: Match each river to a state it flows through.
questions.funFact: Rivers give us water to drink and to grow crops, so many big cities are built on their banks.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a river?
questions.funFact: The Aravalli is not a river but one of the oldest mountain ranges in India.

questions.question: The Narmada and Tapti are unusual rivers because they flow west into the ___.
questions.funFact: Most big Indian rivers flow east, but the Narmada and Tapti head west into the Arabian Sea.

questions.question: The Yamuna is a tributary of the Ganga.
questions.funFact: A tributary is a smaller river that joins a bigger one; the Yamuna is the Ganga's largest tributary.

questions.question: The place at Prayagraj where the Ganga and Yamuna meet is called the ___.
questions.funFact: Huge crowds gather at the Sangam in Prayagraj for the Kumbh Mela, one of the world's largest gatherings.

questions.question: Which river is known as the 'Dakshin Ganga' or Ganga of the South?
questions.funFact: The Godavari starts in Maharashtra and travels across the south before reaching the Bay of Bengal.

questions.question: The holy city of Varanasi is on the banks of the Ganga.
questions.funFact: Varanasi is one of the oldest living cities in the world, and evening prayers called 'aarti' are held on its Ganga steps.
